questions.question: Describe a tin and a ball using the words face and curved surface.
questions.expected_answer: A tin is a cylinder: it has 2 flat circle faces and 1 curved surface. A ball is a sphere: it has no flat faces and only 1 curved surface.

questions.question: A triangular prism and a square-based pyramid both have 5 faces. How are they different?
questions.expected_answer: The triangular prism has 2 triangles and 3 rectangles, with two matching ends. The square-based pyramid has 1 square and 4 triangles that meet at an apex. The faces are different shapes, so they are different objects.

questions.question: Which cut-out polygons do you need to make a cube and a square-based pyramid?
questions.expected_answer: A cube needs 6 equal squares. A square-based pyramid needs 1 square and 4 matching triangles.
